title: feat(console): the desktop bell opens a full-page inbox
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8DfVbMXs7gi65m3Q8RZD83C)_

Fixes #36741

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 电脑上（768 像素以上）点侧栏的铃铛，不再弹出右侧面板，而是进入当前应用里的「收件箱」整页，地址固定可收藏，浏览器后退能回到原页面；手机上不变，仍是面板。
- 整页分三个标签：通知 / 审批 / 动态，各带数量；左边列表，右边直接显示所选内容本身（审批单、通知所指的记录、动态发生的记录），审批可在右边直接同意/驳回，处理完自动跳到下一条。
- 通知点开才标为已读（进页时自动显示的第一条不算），侧栏角标随之减少；重复的定时通知合并成一行并标 ×N；「只看未读」默认开启，本次看过的那条不会突然消失；J / K 上下切换。
- 没有做的几点：服务端没有「标为未读」接口，所以先不放这个按钮；审批标签只列「待我处理」的，其余审批用右上角「全部审批」进入审批中心；右侧嵌入的记录不显示评论，回复评论要点「打开完整记录」。数据和规则都没改。

## What changes

- **Bell entry (desktop).** `InboxPopover` gains `opensPageOnDesktop`; `InboxBell` sets it. From 768 px up the bell is a plain button that pushes `/apps/<app>/inbox` (through the existing unsaved-edits leave guard), keeps the same badge and accessible name, and is `aria-current="page"` on the inbox. Below 768 px, and for any host that does not set the prop, the right-hand panel is unchanged.
- **Route.** `inbox` and `inbox/:inboxTab` (`approvals`, `activity`) join the app route table as a lazy chunk; the selected row is `?item=<id>`, so every view is a bookmarkable address and Back works.
- **Page (`views/inbox/`).** Header with the three tabs and their counts (the bell's own unread-topic count, the pending-approvals total, activity), «Unread only», «Mark all read» (which posts the read-all receipt itself when the only unread rows are older ones loaded on the page), «All approvals». Left list rows carry app, kind, time, title, summary, unread dot and the ×N of a coalesced topic. «Needs your action: N pending approvals» sits on top of Notifications and opens the Approvals tab.
- **Right pane.** Every subject is `RecordDetailView` in its `embedded` form, so nothing re-implements a record or a decision: an approval row is the served `sys_approval_request` page (its decision panel runs the request's own declared actions); a notification is the record its link names (or the request, for an approvals link), with every occurrence of a coalesced topic listed — an embedded record leaves its comments to its full page (#36225), so a reply goes through «Open full record»; an activity row is the record it happened on. «Open full record» goes to the canonical record address.
- **Reads.** The row shown on arrival is not marked read; opening a notification (a click, J / K, or an address naming it) marks its whole coalesced row read through the bell's own write and re-reads the shared feed, so the sidebar badge drops at once. Rows older than the shared 20-row window load on demand («Load earlier»). The approvals tab reads up to 100 pending requests through the same request the shared feed uses, refreshed on the `sys_approval_request` invalidation bus; a decided request hands the selection to the next one.
- **Keyboard.** J / K move the selection, never while typing or with a dialog open.
- **Other doors.** A linkless arrival toast and Home's notifications column open this page instead of the `sys_inbox_message?view=mine` list. A phone is read from the viewport, not from `useIsMobile`'s first-frame `false`, so it neither gets the page link nor has a row picked for it.
- **i18n.** One `inboxPage` block (14 keys) in all 11 packs (no plural keys), a widening of the published packs; the zh-Hans `sidebar.inbox` and `inboxAriaLabel` now say 收件箱; zh-Hant regenerated from zh-Hans.

## Why

Warren's ruling on the epic #36107 phase 2 (2026-11-23): the full-page inbox replaces the right-hand panel on desktop, so an item can be handled where it is read instead of jumping out of a narrow panel.

## Acceptance notes

- «Mark as unread» is not offered: the server has no mark-unread endpoint (`/api/v1/notifications/read` and `read/all` only), and this card changes no data rules.
- The Approvals tab lists the requests waiting on the viewer (the card's «only mine to handle» filter is therefore always on); every other approval stays in the approvals centre, one click away.
- The right pane shows no comments: an embedded record leaves them, and the composer, to its full page (objectstack#36225); a reply goes through «Open full record».
- «Load earlier» pages by row offset past the shared 20-row window, so a message that arrives while older pages are open can shift a row across a page boundary; the next load may then skip it until the page is reopened.
- The phone's panel keeps its «View all» link to the `sys_inbox_message` list, since the card leaves the phone unchanged.

## Verification

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run` over `packages/app-shell/src/views/inbox/`, `layout/__tests__/Inbox*`, `layout/__tests__/AppHeader*`, `layout/__tests__/ConsoleLayout*`, `layout/__tests__/UnifiedSidebar*`, `hooks/`, `layout/__tests__/PhoneAppNavBar*`, `console/__tests__/AppContent*`, `console/__tests__/appRoute*`, `console/__tests__/ConsoleShell*`, `console/home/` and `packages/i18n/`: all green. New pins: `inboxPageModel-36741`, `InboxPage-36741`, `InboxPopover.fullPage-36741`, `useInboxPageApprovals-36741`. Home's and the arrival toast's linkless pins now expect `/apps/<app>/inbox`; `vite-declared-lazy-views` counts the new lazy view.
- The existing bell-panel pins (`AppHeader.inboxVariant`, `AppHeader.deferredChromeReads-12980`, `sharedInboxFeed.twoSurfaces`) now draw the header at phone width, where the panel still lives; their assertions are unchanged.
- `pnpm --dir ui/packages/app-shell type-check` clean; eslint on the changed files: 0 errors.
- Local gates from `dispatch-gates --commands` relevant to the diff (changeset, sdui manifest, published files, test-source alias, undeclared deps, type-check coverage, …) pass; `overlap-check` clean against `main` and #36525.
- Browser check at 1280 px on the showcase app (dev console against a local `objectstack dev --seed-admin` stack, signed in as the seeded admin, Chinese UI): the sidebar bell pushes `/apps/com.example.showcase/inbox?item=…`; tabs show 通知 4 / 审批 5; a twice-reassigned task is one row with ×2 and both occurrences in the pane, which embeds the task; J moves `?item=`; Back from the activity tab returns to the task list in one step. On the approvals tab, rejecting the selected request in the embedded decision panel (comment required by the request's own action) moved the selection to the next request, the list went 5 → 4 and the sidebar badge 8 → 7. Screenshots are on the project thread (kept out of git).
- The zh-Hans name of the bell's surface (`sidebar.inbox`, `inboxAriaLabel`) now says 收件箱, as the card names the page (it read 消息中心; every other pack already said Inbox); zh-Hant regenerated.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
